notes.title: Update EA 02 : Codename Droky
notes.notes:
[h1]Salutations Runners ![/h1]

With this update, we adress a whole bunch of issues regarding item, their performances and their late game balances, in order to reinforce drastically their usage and the viability of certain combination. The large majority of items have been patched to a non-linear progression, noted NLP in the patch. It means that the more you have of a specific item, the less bonuses you gain from newly obtained exemplary, up to a hard limit.

Here is the list of balance and fixes :

[h2]Legendary items :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Horsehoe : Base 1% => up to 10%, and up to 75%(NLP).
[*] Scroll : Change from -10 kill require by item to +1 level up by item (no retroactive)
[*] Dice : Update info about being non-craftable
[*] Mushroom : change scaling up to 100% increase in stats (NLP).
[/list]

[h2]Rare items :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gold Coin : change scaling up to 100% increase in chances (NLP).
[*] Warhammer : Change scaling for radius up to a 10m radius, and increase base damage gain from 2.5% to 10% (NLP).
[*] Question-marked Dice : Change scaling from a base +15% up to 100% (NLP).
[*] Magic Orb : Change scaling from 1% up to 50% and increase initial chance to 10% (NLP).
[*] Vaudou Doll : Change base value to 100% and scale up to +25% dmg and radius per item. Moreover, it removes now "only" 99.9% of your life regeneration, remaining rounded up, instead of negating it. The damage is now a hit applying effect on hit.
[*] Bottled Cloud : Change scaling down to 10% (NLP).
[/list]

[h2]Uncommon items :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Poison Bottle : Change base value to an initial 10% with a scaling of up to 100% (NLP).
[*] Gauntlet : Change scaling to an initial 10% chance and up to a 100% scaling (NLP), and increase by 25% the damage reduction. 
[*] Spiked Mace : Change scaling to an initial 10% chance and up to 75% (NLP).
[*] Pillow : Change scaling to an initial 25% and up to 100% (NLP).
[*] Sanguine Powder : Change scaling to an initial 25% and up to 1000% (NLP).
[*] Ice crystal : Change scaling to an initial 10% chance and up to 100% (NLP).
[*] Mirror: Change scaling to an initial 100% and up to 100000% (Note : As monsters deal way less damage than players on average, the boost is necessary)
[*] Bombs : Change scaling to +10% per item on radius, and scaling up to +1000% (NLP).
[/list]

[h2]Common items :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reactive Armor : Change damage scaling of the explosion to 50% per item
[*] Helmet : Change initial scaling to 10% and up to 90% scaling (NLP).
[*] Shoulder Pad : Change initial scaling to 20% and a linear +10% per item  
[*] Morningstar : Change for a scaling of +25%
[*] Iron Boots and Slipper : Change the scaling for an initial +15% and a linear +5% per item
[*] Book : Change initial scaling to 25% and up to 1000% (NLP).
[*] Rings (all) : Change initial scaling to 10% and up to 90% (NLP).
[*] Leather Armor : Change initial scaling to 10% and up to 100% (NLP).
[*] Rabbit Charm : Change initial scaling to 10% and up to 90% (NLP). 
[*] 4 Leaves Clover : Change scaling of +2% per item
[*] Feather : Double the effectiveness of the item
[/list]


With all these changes, the "Hard" mode of the game become way more affordable for runners that have already unlocked few items in other difficulties, and will allow them to tackle the game in higher difficulty and challenges.


[b]We wish you a happy death, with all our affection

Random Synapse Team[/b]



[b]PS :[/b] The patch note have been named after Drokynor, one of our very dear friend that support us throughout our developement by aiding us in QA, test, translation, community management, discord management, website, motivation and coffee. Without him, Storm's Eye would be way lot buggy and strange.  With all our love, thank you Droky !

notes.title: Major Update EA 01 : It's Scoring Time !
notes.notes:
[h1][u][b]Hello dear Runners ![/b][/u][/h1]

We hope that you fought well and died a lot ! (with a smile, please.)

In the mean-time (hehe), we did pretty much the same in real life to bring you a deliciously viscious patch with plenty in it. 

So, what's in it for [b]you[/b] ? 


[h2]Scores and Leaderboards[/h2]

It's finally here, the pointless and nonetheless thrilling friendly competition on who's getting the biggest number in the end ! Ladies and gentlemen, bow to the mighty [b]LEADERBOARD[/b]!

Throughout your run, a score will be calculated base on your performance and the difficulty, and will allow you to show who's the boss to that one friend that unlocked "Backpack" achievement faster than anyone.

Even if you are friendless (which is clearly concerning, we have a discord and cookies, don't hesitate to drop by !), the Leaderboard is community wide and will allow you to see if you rank among the best (or the beast) ! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2696570/leaderboards/13504838/]You can access it here.[/url]

This score is roughly based on monsters killed, objectives completed, last arena reached, and your average map completion time.


[h2]Multiplayer QOL[/h2]

In addition of a reason to kill the friend that brag the most, we also pick up on feedback about multiplayer issues for a better gaming experience. 

You'll now see the health and shield bars of your fellow runners, be notified when they die, see their name above their head, and an arrow will indicate in which direction they are when one of them gets past your screen's edge. 

We are also in discussion about implementing a feature that would allow players to sacrifice items to help a fellow "Backpack" in dire need of said items. We will keep you update about that.


[h2]Engine Update & Framerate Improvement[/h2]

While we are probably the only one excited about it as devs, there is something in for you : an average +30% performance boost on average configuration, and even more on high end settings for higher hardwares. Small configuration would still have around a +20% framerate improvement overall.


[h2]And Many More[/h2]

And a whole bunch of patch, balancing, bugfix, sound localisation, and everything that goes with it. Here is a sorted-but-not-too-much list about it :

[h3]Classes :[/h3]

[b]Warrior[/b]
[list]
[*]Added an aim offset for a better user experience
[*]Increased base sword range
[*]Decreased attack speed of Normal ability slightly
[/list]

[b]Archer[/b]
[list]
[*]Its Normal ability (left click by default) has a better hitbox penetration to hit weakpoints more easily
[*]Increased its Offensive ability damage
[/list]

[b]Lancer[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased its Offensive ability damage
[/list]

[b]All classes[/b]
[list]
[*] Balance level up condition of Offensive abilities, from "Hit monsters" to "Kill monsters"
[/list]

[h3]Monsters[/h3]
[list]
[*] The JellyFish health bar now properly shows damage taken
[*] Now monsters stay correctly in their knockback animation when stunned
[*] Monsters' AI will now try to get back to their nav mesh when outside of it
[*] Fix secondary objectives not correctly improving bosses' loot rate
[*] Fix additional spawners on Barricade and Ruins arenas
[*] The damage threshold monsters have to suffer to cancel their animation was decreased from 25 to 20 %
[*] Increase knockback duration on monsters after their animation cancellation from 0.2s to 0.3s
[/list]

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "Hold the Line" achievement should now work properly
[*] "Impact Point" achievement is now implemented
[*] "No Scratch" and other achievements related to the campfire should now be obtainable correctly
[/list]

[h3]Items related[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix the item applying a random effect on attacks, it can now apply stun and freeze effects too
[*] Fix the item giving more of each other items owned during the run, it can now roll a 6
[*] Fix the item transforming health regen into damage, now damage is properly applied to monsters instead of player
[*] Recycle on crafting table don't give back one of the items used during an attempt
[*] Fix Armor bar being shown even after player removed all his armor with the crafting table
[/list]

[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a VFX feedback on collectible supplies
[*] Removed monster weapon shadows for Medium shadow quality or less
[*] "Join session" and "return to host menu" buttons in Join menu are disabled if player click on it to show loading and to prevent spam
[*] Timer in lobby will now be blue instead of red
[*] Fixed directional hit indicator for clients in multiplayer
[*] Invisible walls now give a hints on where there are
[*] Fall damage are now properly rounded as integers
[*] Improvements made when a critical amount of monsters is reached (caches upgrade)
[*] Reworked primary objectives of Ruins and Barricade arenas as well as their visual appearance, to clarify their goal. 
[*] Additional lore and stories splattered all around, be aware Runners !
[/list]


On that note, we wish you an happy death (in game of course), and we hope to see you on Discord with your feedbacks !

With much love,
Random Synapse Team.
